Do not reach for the weapon.
Keep your hands visible.
Inform the officer calmly if required in your jurisdiction.
Follow commands without sudden movements.
Do not consent to anything you do not wish to consent to; state your position clearly and calmly.
Ask for a lawyer if you are being questioned or detained.
Learn your state’s transport, carry, and disclosure laws before carrying again.
